ROIs for blood (plasma/serum) samples

Source: R/to_rDolphin_blood.R
ROI_blood.Rd

The template ROI_blood contains the targeted list of metabolites to be quantified (blood samples)

References

github.com/danielcanueto/rDolphin

Examples

data("ROI_blood")
ROI_blood[ROI_blood$Metabolite == "Valine", ]
#>   ROI.left.edge..ppm. ROI.right.edge..ppm. Quantification.Mode Metabolite
#> 3                1.02                0.973    Baseline Fitting     Valine
#> 5                1.06                1.015    Baseline Fitting     Valine
#>   Quantification.Signal Chemical.shift.ppm. Chemical.shift.tolerance..ppm.
#> 3                     2              0.9850                           0.01
#> 5                     1              1.0356                           0.01
#>   Half.bandwidth..Hz. Multiplicity J.coupling..Hz. Roof.effect HMDB_code
#> 3                 1.4            2            7.01           0        NA
#> 5                 1.4            2            7.05           0        NA
